newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close firm on election eve.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close firm on election eve.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed steady ahead of Friday's local government poll, with heavy trading in a blue chip stock, brokers said.
The all-share index closed 0.35 points lower at 632.65. Price falls edged out gains by 24 to 17. Development Finance Corporation fell 2.75 rupees to 252.50, Kelani Valley Plantations one to 27.

"Despite caution ahead of elections it was not difficult to find buyers for good quantities of selected blue chips with growth potential," said Prasanna Chandrasekera, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Turnover was 56.9 million rupees on 811,506 shares, led by 124,900 shares of the blue chip Development Finance Corporation.

"Investors used the runup to the election to take a break from the hectic trading they had been involved in during the previous few weeks," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena, a trader at brokerage Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
Active trading this year has taken the Colombo index up 4.2 percent or 25.95 points, on the back of good corporate results in the last quarter of 1996, brokers said.
